text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Oh, did Espo's mom reply!? Let's see... 
'I'm relieved to see you having fun on 
your birthday'――

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
And also, 'Be sure to tell your friends 
they're totally welcome to come over!' 
...she said. Woohoo!!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, hearing you say that really makes me 
want to meet her. Espo-senpai's mom, that 
is.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"I agree! In that case, let's go see them! 
Espo, City! When's your next day off?"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! What are you going ahead without me 
for?! I was holding back so hard, too...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hold back...? Holding back from seeing 
you, you mean...?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Wha—no... That was a slip of the tongue!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Like I'd wanna meet up just 'cause it's 
your birthday... As if I'd ever think of 
something so whiny and childish like 
that!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Change of plans! Seize the day! Today's 
the day—let's go see her today! Sounds 
good, right, City!?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Mm, agreed. I don't have any work today 
anyway.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? It's not like *I* wanted to see you 
or anything...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
No, we just want to meet her, simple as 
that. So... come on, Espo-senpai, why 
don't we at least try making an 
appointment with your mother?
